body:
consider this your permission to go shopping 🤍 tap the little shopping-bag tab, open whichever era owns your heart, and see the real pieces behind her looks. every photo links straight out to where it's sold. go treat yourself.

longlivets.com/?mode=merch&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=launch
mediaCredit: Paolo Villanueva (CC BY 2.0), via Wikimedia Commons
altText: Taylor Swift performing the reputation set of the Eras Tour in Inglewood, 2023, in a black snake-motif costume under dark green stage lighting.
why: Launch arc +3 (how-to), 09-15 calendar beat. Challenge/invitation hook, written distinct from the IG sibling (which lists the steps) to clear the cross-post-copy gate. Mechanics verified live: Merch tab with shopping-bag icon (TopBar.tsx/BottomNav.tsx), buy-link tiles open the retailer in a new tab (MerchCard.tsx target=_blank), seen-on-Taylor tiles labeled 'her look, not the product'. Photo-only (no 'Seen on Taylor' screenshot committed; X site-screen prohibited anyway). Selector-chosen credited reputation photo, distinct era from the IG 1989 tile. Avoided the raid-your-closet phrasing reserved for the 09-21 callback. Launch post = share-hook exempt.

critique.rationale: Launch arc +3 how-to: a warm invitation to the merch surface — shopping-bag tab, open your era, every photo links out to where the piece is sold. Mechanics verified live in MerchCard.tsx/TopBar.tsx; challenge hook, photo-only per the no-screenshot rule.
